Package com.github.jpmsilva.jsystemd.spring

Class NettyStatusProvider

java.lang.Object
com.github.jpmsilva.jsystemd.spring.NettyStatusProvider
All Implemented Interfaces:
StatusProvider, Function<reactor.netty.http.server.HttpServer,reactor.netty.http.server.HttpServer>, NettyServerCustomizer
public class NettyStatusProvider extends Object implements StatusProvider, NettyServerCustomizer
Implementation of StatusProvider that provides information regarding the embedded Reactor Netty servers of the application.

For each server, named after the port it listens on, it reports the open connections and the requests being handled, such as netty-8080: 12 connections, 3 requests. Reactor Netty handles requests on a few event loop threads, which never block, so there is no thread pool to report on. A server that is not listening is left out.

Reactor Netty does not count its connections and requests unless it records metrics with Micrometer, so this provider counts them itself: it is a NettyServerCustomizer, which Spring Boot applies to the servers it creates, the server of the application as well as the server of the management endpoints when they use a port of their own. Only the connections and requests of the servers created after it are counted.

Author:
Joao Silva
